Checking saved expedition routes…

Miles are estimated from GPS Flight Recorder tracks you chose to save. No tracking starts automatically. Unsaved miles aren't included in the all-time total.

📍 Nearby Places

One tap opens a nearby search in Google Maps. Listings, opening hours and availability are provided by Google Maps, not verified by this app.

Google Maps opens separately. If the app has GPS permission, searches can include your current coordinates; otherwise Google Maps can locate you.

🚗 Find My Parked Car

Park up, save your current GPS position and return using walking directions. Stored on this phone only. Save bike and car locations independently.

No car location saved yet.

🏍️ Find My Bike

Save the location where you parked, then get walking directions back. Your parking pin is saved only on this phone, never to Firebase.

No bike location saved yet.

🥾 Return to Starting Point

Save your departure point before exploring. The saved pin works even if GPS tracking isn't running.

No starting point saved.

🌅 Daylight & Sunset

Enable location to check estimated sunrise, sunset and time remaining today.

Sunrise and sunset via Open-Meteo, when online. Estimates are not a guarantee of usable light in valleys or woodland.

🆘 Emergency Position

Shows your coordinates so you can communicate your location. Always use the appropriate emergency services when needed.

No current location requested in this session.
For an up-to-date position, tap Get CURRENT Location. It never starts automatic tracking.

📍 Last Known Location NO SAVED FIX

Saved automatically on this phone only after a successful location request in Expedition Essentials. Still available after reopening the app. Not continuous tracking.

No previous GPS position saved yet.

A last known position may be out of date. Always try Get CURRENT Location first.

Shares one recorded GPS fix, never live tracking. Every message includes capture time and reported accuracy. Sending needs signal; for a real emergency call 999 or 112. This is not a rescue service.
